name: @sumirati/mcp-github

tools.name: github_find_actions
tools.description: Search and discover available GitHub actions in the 83-action catalog by keyword query or domain filter. Use this discovery tool first whenever you need to perform an action outside the 3 eager daily drivers (e.g. managing PRs, issues, releases, workflows, collaborators, webhooks, variables, security alerts). Returns matching action names, domain categories, mutating flags, descriptions, and parameter signatures so you can construct the call for github_execute_action.

query.description: Search keyword query to match against action names, domains, or descriptions (e.g. 'pull request', 'issue comment', 'webhook', 'deploy', 'dependabot')

domain.description: Optional domain filter to restrict discovery to a specific functional category

format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, compact human/LLM-readable text table) or 'json' (structured object with parameter schemas)

tools.name: github_execute_action
tools.description: Execute any supported GitHub action from the 83-action catalog by action name with parameters. Requires the exact action name (discovered via github_find_actions) and its corresponding argument dictionary. Output is automatically compressed with strict token projection filters (stripping hypermedia URL templates, avatar links, empty fields, node_ids) and formatted as compact Markdown by default. Mutating actions are blocked when running in read-only mode (GITHUB_READ_ONLY=true).

action.description: Exact name of the GitHub action to execute (e.g. 'create_pull_request', 'list_issues', 'trigger_workflow', 'create_branch')

params.description: Parameters dictionary for the action matching its parameter schema

format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, token-optimized compact table/text for LLM) or 'json' (structured JSON)

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Read current file contents, extract symbol outlines, slice line ranges, or list directory entries from a repository at a specified git ref without cloning. Automatically decodes Base64 file contents into plain text UTF-8. Eager daily driver tool for inspecting source code, configuration files, and directory layouts.

owner.description: Repository owner (user or organization, e.g. 'octocat' or 'buggycode')

path.description: Relative path to file or directory in repository (e.g. 'README.md', 'src/index.js', or '' for root)

ref.description: Git reference (branch name, tag, or commit SHA) to read from (default: default branch / HEAD)

outline_only.description: Extract top-level symbol signatures (functions, classes, interfaces, types) with line numbers to conserve tokens (default: false)

start_line.description: Optional 1-based start line to slice file contents

end_line.description: Optional 1-based end line to slice file contents

tools.name: get_repository
tools.description: Get comprehensive repository metadata, visibility, description, default branch, HTML URL, star count, fork count, and open issues count for an owner/repo. Eager daily driver tool for verifying repository configuration and existence.

owner.description: Repository owner (user or organization, e.g. 'octocat' or 'buggycode')

tools.name: get_commit
tools.description: Get detailed commit metadata, author information, message, and unified git diffs for a specific commit SHA or reference. Eager daily driver tool for reviewing code modifications, patches, or investigating regressions. Output diffs are token-optimized and automatically truncated to max_diff_lines (default: 400 lines).

owner.description: Repository owner (user or organization, e.g. 'octocat' or 'buggycode')

ref.description: Commit SHA, branch name, or tag reference to inspect

path.description: Optional file path filter: only include diff and stats for this single file

max_diff_lines.description: Maximum unified diff lines to return across files to conserve LLM context tokens (default: 400)

ignore_lockfiles.description: If true, automatically collapses diffs for lockfiles and minified assets (default: true)
